discipline: K-stage HYPOTHESES, not mechanisms. Levers from PROPERTY_CODEBOOK drivers. evidence_ref = experiment SET that measured the property (NOT lever-isolated) -> every row defaults to status=HYPOTHESIS. Upgrades to PARTIAL/VERIFIED only when a controlled to_verify experiment is bound. Reversible; no DB write; approval-gated per row.

rows.mechanism: Intumescent triad: APP releases phosphoric acid catalyzing PER charring; MEL releases NH3/CO2 expanding the char into insulating foam; binder dilutes the triad; nanoclay reinforces cell walls.
rows.to_verify: Hold base fixed; vary APP alone in 3 steps; measure expansion_ratio. Directional+isolated -> VERIFIED. Repeat per lever.

rows.mechanism: Intumescent char (same triad) forms a low-conductivity foamed barrier insulating the substrate and delaying its temperature rise.
rows.to_verify: EN 13381-8 / cone on a controlled APP-only and MEL-only ladder. Only 3 experiments -> weak base, expand first.

rows.mechanism: Char quality (cohesion/density/adhesion of residue) set by carbon source PER and reinforced by nanoclay platelets bridging the char; APP supplies crosslinking acid. Poor char = too little PER/nanoclay vs blowing.
rows.to_verify: Vary nanoclay alone; score char by rubric; check cohesion/crack resistance tracks nanoclay.

rows.mechanism: Binder wets substrate and forms the interfacial bond; high APP filler load dilutes binder at the interface and introduces weak boundary layers -> high APP lowers adhesion.
rows.to_verify: Pull-off D4541 across a binder-fraction ladder at fixed APP; then APP-only ladder for the dilution effect.

rows.mechanism: Wet viscosity built by the rheology-modifier network: RM-825 associative bridging; Xanthan/Cellulose H-bonded networks; nanoclay house-of-cards. OROTAN de-flocculates; water lowers solids.
rows.to_verify: Brookfield across an RM-825-only ladder at fixed solids; confirm monotonic rise.
